extension.summary: Installs and updates the Telegram Media add-on
extension.description: Repository for the Telegram Media Kodi add-on.

extension.summary: Browse photos and videos from your Telegram channels, groups and chats
extension.description: Logs in with your own Telegram account (MTProto via Telethon) and lists every channel, group and chat individually, plus combined Images, Videos and Mixed sections across all of them. Videos stream through a local server with seeking support. Requires your own api_id/api_hash from my.telegram.org.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Telegram. Your session key is stored in the add-on profile folder - anyone with that file can access your Telegram account.
extension.news: 1.3.0: Much faster on Android/ARM boxes (uses Kodi's own OpenSSL instead of pure-Python decryption); photos open in a slideshow so left/right switches images. 1.2.0: Unread section (chats with unread messages and their new photos/videos); combined All lists load much faster with many chats. 1.1.0: Log in by scanning a QR code with the Telegram app (no SMS/login code needed).
